function.name: nulldrv_AngleArc
function.description: This function calculates the start and end points of an arc based on the given parameters, sets the arc direction, draws the arc using NtGdiArcInternal function, and then resets the arc direction.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Physical device for which the arc is to be drawn

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X-coordinate of the center of the arc

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y-coordinate of the center of the arc

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius of the arc

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Starting angle of the arc in degrees

parameters.name: sweep
parameters.description: Sweep angle of the arc in degrees

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the arc was successfully drawn or not

function.name: nulldrv_ArcTo
function.description: This function calculates the parameters for an arc and draws it using the NtGdiArcInternal function. It also draws a line from the current position to the starting point of the arc.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Device context to draw on

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Left coordinate of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Top coordinate of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Right coordinate of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: Bottom coordinate of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: xstart
parameters.description: X coordinate of the starting point of the arc

parameters.name: ystart
parameters.description: Y coordinate of the starting point of the arc

parameters.name: xend
parameters.description: X coordinate of the ending point of the arc

parameters.name: yend
parameters.description: Y coordinate of the ending point of the arc

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the arc is successfully drawn, FALSE otherwise

function.name: nulldrv_FillRgn
function.description: This function fills a region with a specified brush. It first selects the brush into the device context, then calls the pPaintRgn function of the physical device, and finally reselects the previous brush into the device context.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the physical device where the region will be filled.

parameters.name: rgn
parameters.description: This is the region that will be filled with the brush.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: This is the brush that will be used to fill the region.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the region was successfully filled or not.

function.name: nulldrv_FrameRgn
function.description: This function creates a rectangular region, frames it, fills it with a specified brush, and then deletes the region.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Device context to be used for the operation

parameters.name: rgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region to be framed

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Handle to the brush used to fill the region

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the region

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the region

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the operation was successful or not

function.name: nulldrv_InvertRgn
function.description: This function inverts the colors in a specified region by using the specified device context.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the device context that the function uses to perform the inversion.

parameters.name: rgn
parameters.description: This is the region in which the colors are to be inverted.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function successfully inverted the colors in the specified region or not.

function.name: polyline
function.description: This function draws a polyline on a device context using the provided points.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context where the polyline is to be drawn.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of POINT structures that contains the vertices of the polyline.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of points in the array.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful in drawing the polyline.

function.name: nulldrv_PolyBezier
function.description: This function is used to draw a Bezier curve based on the provided points. It uses the GDI_Bezier function to calculate the points of the curve, then draws the curve using the polyline function.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is a physical device object that the function will draw on.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: This is an array of points that define the Bezier curve.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: This is the number of points in the points array.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the Bezier curve was successfully drawn, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: nulldrv_PolyBezierTo
function.description: This function draws a PolyBezier using the provided points and count. It first gets the DC from the provided PHYSDEV, then allocates memory for the points. It then copies the points into the allocated memory and increments the count. It then calls NtGdiPolyPolyDraw to draw the PolyBezier. If the points were successfully allocated, it frees the memory and returns the result of the draw call.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the device context to draw on.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: This is an array of points that define the PolyBezier.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: This is the number of points in the points array.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the PolyBezier was successfully drawn or not.

function.name: nulldrv_PolyDraw
function.description: This function draws lines and curves using the specified points. It checks for valid point types, allocates memory for line points, and performs operations based on the type of point. It also handles memory reallocation and cleanup.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Physical device to be used for drawing

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of points to be used for drawing

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of types corresponding to the points

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of points to be drawn

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully draws the lines and curves, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: nulldrv_PolylineTo
function.description: This function draws a polyline on a device context associated with a given PHYSDEV object. It uses the POINT array and count to determine the vertices of the polyline.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the physical device object on which the polyline is to be drawn.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an array of POINT structures that contains the vertices of the polyline.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: This is the number of points in the points array.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the polyline was successfully drawn or not.

function.name: NtGdiLineTo
function.description: This function draws a line from the current position up to, but not including, the specified point.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to a device context.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the line's ending point.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the line's ending point.

function.return_type: BOOL. If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtGdiMoveTo
function.description: This function moves the current position to the specified coordinates and optionally returns the previous position.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The new x-coordinate.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The new y-coordinate.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Pointer to a POINT structure that receives the previous current position. If this parameter is NULL, the previous position is not returned.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the function is successful. Otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiArcInternal
function.description: This function is used to draw different types of arcs based on the type parameter. It can draw a simple arc, an arc to a specific point, a chord, or a pie. The arc is drawn within the rectangle defined by the left, top, right, and bottom parameters. The arc starts at the point defined by xstart and ystart and ends at the point defined by xend and yend.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: This parameter defines the type of arc to be drawn.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle to the device context.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: This parameter defines the left side of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: This parameter defines the top side of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: This parameter defines the right side of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: This parameter defines the bottom side of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: xstart
parameters.description: This parameter defines the x-coordinate of the start point of the arc.

parameters.name: ystart
parameters.description: This parameter defines the y-coordinate of the start point of the arc.

parameters.name: xend
parameters.description: This parameter defines the x-coordinate of the end point of the arc.

parameters.name: yend
parameters.description: This parameter defines the y-coordinate of the end point of the arc.

function.return_type: BOOL. This function returns TRUE if the function is successful. Otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiEllipse
function.description: This function draws an ellipse that fits into the specified rectangle, using the device context specified.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Specifies the x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Specifies the y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Specifies the x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: Specifies the y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful in drawing the ellipse. Returns TRUE if successful; otherwise FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiRectangle
function.description: This function draws a rectangle on a device context using the specified dimensions.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Specifies the x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Specifies the y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Specifies the x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: Specifies the y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, FALSE if it fails.

function.name: NtGdiRoundRect
function.description: This function draws a rectangle with rounded corners. The rectangle is outlined by using the current pen and filled by using the current brush.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Specifies the x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Specifies the y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Specifies the x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: Specifies the y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle.

parameters.name: ell_width
parameters.description: Specifies the width of the ellipse used to create the rounded corners.

parameters.name: ell_height
parameters.description: Specifies the height of the ellipse used to create the rounded corners.

function.return_type: BOOL. If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtGdiSetPixel
function.description: This function sets the pixel at the specified coordinates to a specified color.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the pixel.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the pixel.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: The color to set the pixel.

function.return_type: COLORREF, represents the final color that the pixel was set to.

function.name: NtGdiGetPixel
function.description: This function retrieves the red, green, blue (RGB) color value of the pixel at the specified coordinates.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to the device context.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the pixel to be examined.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the pixel to be examined.

function.return_type: COLORREF, represents the RGB color value of the pixel. If the pixel is outside of the current clipping region, it returns CLR_INVALID.

function.name: NtGdiSetPixelFormat
function.description: This function sets the pixel format for a device context. If the pixel format has not been set, it assigns the provided format. If the pixel format has already been set, it checks if the existing format matches the provided format.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: This is a handle to the device context.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: This is the pixel format to be set.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the pixel format was successfully set or if the existing format matches the provided format. Returns FALSE if the device context could not be retrieved.

function.name: NtGdiDescribePixelFormat
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It is intended to describe the pixel format of a device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specifies the number that identifies the pixel format to describe.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Specifies the size, in bytes, of the structure pointed to by descr.

parameters.name: descr
parameters.description: Pointer to a PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR structure that contains the logical pixel format specification.

function.return_type: INT, represents the maximum pixel format index of the device context. In this stub function, it always returns 0.

function.name: NtGdiSwapBuffers
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It always returns FALSE.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to the device context.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents the success or failure of the function. In this case, always returns FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiCancelDC
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It always returns TRUE.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function.

function.return_type: BOOL, always returns TRUE

function.name: NtGdiFillRgn
function.description: This function fills a region with a specified brush.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region to be filled.

parameters.name: hbrush
parameters.description: Handle to the brush to be used for filling.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful or not. Returns TRUE if successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: NtGdiFrameRgn
function.description: This function is used to draw a border around the specified region using the specified brush.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region.

parameters.name: hbrush
parameters.description: Handle to the brush.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the border.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the border.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, FALSE if it fails.

function.name: NtGdiInvertRgn
function.description: This function inverts the colors in the specified region.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful or not.

function.name: NtGdiPolyPolyDraw
function.description: This function is used to draw complex shapes and lines based on the function parameter. It can handle multiple types of drawing functions such as PolyPolygon, PolyPolyline, PolyBezier, PolyBezierTo, and PolylineTo.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to a device context.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of POINT structures that define the vertices of the polygons or lines to be drawn.

parameters.name: counts
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of ULONG integers, each element of which specifies the count of points in the corresponding polygon or line.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Specifies the total number of integers in the counts array.

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Specifies the drawing function to be performed. It can be one of the following: NtGdiPolyPolygon, NtGdiPolyPolyline, NtGdiPolyBezier, NtGdiPolyBezierTo, NtGdiPolylineTo, NtGdiPolyPolygonRgn.

function.return_type: ULONG. Returns the result of the drawing operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is non-zero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtGdiExtFloodFill
function.description: This function fills an area of the display surface with the specified color.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the point to be filled.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the point to be filled.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: The color to fill the area.

parameters.name: fill_type
parameters.description: The type of fill operation to be performed.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function is successful; otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiAngleArc
function.description: This function draws a line segment of an arc. The arc is specified by a radius and two radian values. The line segment is drawn from the start angle to the end angle.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to the device context.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the center of the arc.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the center of the arc.

parameters.name: dwRadius
parameters.description: The radius of the arc.

parameters.name: start_angle
parameters.description: The start angle of the arc, in degrees.

parameters.name: sweep_angle
parameters.description: The sweep angle of the arc, in degrees.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the function is successful, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiPolyDraw
function.description: This function is used to draw complex shapes on a device context. It gets the device context pointer, updates it, and then calls the pPolyDraw function of the physical device. If the drawing is successful and the count is not zero, it updates the current position in the device context attributes to the last point in the points array. Finally, it releases the device context pointer and returns the result of the drawing operation.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of POINT structures that contains the vertices of the polygon to be drawn.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of BYTE that specifies the type of each point in the points array.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Specifies the total number of points.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the drawing operation was successful or not.

function.name: BezierCheck
function.description: This function checks if the control points of a Bezier curve are between the start and end points, and whether the curve is a shallow or steep line. It returns a boolean value based on these checks.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an array of POINT structures representing the points of a Bezier curve.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the control points are between the start and end points and the curve meets the conditions for being a shallow or steep line, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: GDI_InternalBezier
function.description: This function is used to calculate the Bezier curve points and store them in an array. It uses recursion to divide the curve into smaller segments until a certain level of precision is reached.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: This is the input array of points that define the Bezier curve.

parameters.name: PtsOut
parameters.description: This is the output array where the calculated points of the Bezier curve will be stored.

parameters.name: dwOut
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an integer that specifies the current size of the PtsOut array.

parameters.name: nPtsOut
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an integer that specifies the current number of points in the PtsOut array.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: This is the level of precision for the Bezier curve calculation. The higher the level, the more precise the curve.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but modifies the PtsOut array.

function.name: GDI_Bezier
function.description: This function calculates the Bezier curve points based on the input points and returns the calculated points.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: An array of points that define the Bezier curve.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of points in the Points array.

parameters.name: nPtsOut
parameters.description: A pointer to an integer that receives the number of points calculated for the Bezier curve.

function.return_type: POINT*, represents the array of points that make up the calculated Bezier curve.

function.name: NtGdiGradientFill
function.description: This function fills a rectangle or triangle with a gradient color. It checks for valid parameters, retrieves a device context, updates it, and calls a function to perform the gradient fill, then releases the device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: vert_array
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of TRIVERTEX structures that define the endpoints of the gradient.

parameters.name: nvert
parameters.description: Number of TRIVERTEX structures in the vert_array array.

parameters.name: grad_array
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of gradient fill structures.

parameters.name: ngrad
parameters.description: Number of gradient fill structures in the grad_array array.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Specifies the mode of gradient fill. It can be either GRADIENT_FILL_RECT_H, GRADIENT_FILL_RECT_V, or GRADIENT_FILL_TRIANGLE.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds. If the function fails, it returns FALSE and sets the last error to ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER if any parameter is invalid.

function.name: NtGdiDrawStream
function.description: This function is a stub and does not perform any operation. It simply returns FALSE.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to a device context.

parameters.name: in
parameters.description: An unsigned long integer input.

parameters.name: pvin
parameters.description: A pointer to an unspecified type.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents the success or failure of the function. In this case, it always returns FALSE.

function.name: NtUserScrollDC
function.description: This function scrolls the contents of the specified device context. The scroll direction is specified by the dx and dy parameters. It can also optionally clip the scrolling to a specified rectangle, update a specified rectangle, and return a region that represents the update region.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: Specifies the amount of horizontal scrolling.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: Specifies the amount of vertical scrolling.

parameters.name: scroll
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that specifies the portion of the device context to be scrolled.

parameters.name: clip
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that specifies the clipping rectangle.

parameters.name: ret_update_rgn
parameters.description: Handle to the region that will be updated after scrolling.

parameters.name: update_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure that will receive the bounding rectangle of the update region.

function.return_type: BOOL. If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.
